skill.name: baoyu-format-markdown
skill.description: Formats plain text and Markdown into structured Markdown with frontmatter, title handling, summaries, headings, lists, code blocks, and CJK typography fixes.
skill.summary: Formats drafts into publication-ready Markdown with frontmatter and typography cleanup.
skill.author: jimliu

security_audit.summary: Most static matches are false positives from Markdown backticks, help text, and package lockfile integrity hashes. Confirmed risks remain around shell execution of unescaped file paths, unpinned npx package execution, in-place file writes, and hidden configuration reads.

remediation.issue: Shell command execution uses an interpolated file path.
remediation.suggestion: Replace execSync shell strings with execFile or spawn using an argument array, and validate the target path before execution.

remediation.issue: Runtime tools are invoked through unpinned npx commands.
remediation.suggestion: Pin bun and autocorrect-node versions, install them as declared dependencies, or vendor a reviewed formatter binary.

remediation.issue: Formatter reads and writes arbitrary CLI-provided paths.
remediation.suggestion: Normalize paths, require Markdown extensions, confirm overwrite targets, and always write to a separate output file by default.

remediation.issue: Hidden EXTEND.md files can influence formatting behavior.
remediation.suggestion: Treat EXTEND.md as untrusted input, parse only a strict schema, and ask before applying project or home-level settings.

content.value_statement: Drafts often lack consistent structure, frontmatter, and readable typography. This skill turns plain text or rough Markdown into organized Markdown ready for review.
actual_capabilities: Detects plain text or existing Markdown and asks before optimizing Markdown files.
Creates or updates YAML frontmatter with title, slug, summary, and cover image hints.
Moves an H1 title into frontmatter and avoids duplicate body titles.
Adds Markdown structure such as headings, bold emphasis, lists, blockquotes, and code blocks.
Runs typography cleanup for CJK emphasis, CJK and English spacing, and optional quote replacement.
Saves output as a formatted Markdown copy and can back up an existing formatted file.
limitations: Requires a local file path that the agent can read and write.
May run local scripts and npx packages, so commands should be reviewed before use.
Does not verify facts or improve the accuracy of the source text.
Publication style choices may still need human review.

use_cases.title: Prepare Blog Drafts
use_cases.description: Convert rough article notes into a Markdown post with frontmatter, headings, summaries, and readable sections.

use_cases.title: Clean Documentation Notes
use_cases.description: Standardize headings, lists, inline commands, and code block language labels before documentation review.

use_cases.title: Standardize Bilingual Markdown
use_cases.description: Apply CJK and English spacing, emphasis fixes, and consistent Markdown structure to multilingual content.

prompt_templates.title: Format a Draft
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a plain text draft.
prompt_templates.prompt: Format this plain text file into Markdown. Preserve the original meaning and save a formatted copy.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Existing Markdown
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve structure while keeping existing content.
prompt_templates.prompt: Optimize this Markdown file with frontmatter, headings, lists, and typography cleanup. Ask before changing existing structure.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Typography Only
prompt_templates.scenario: Clean spacing and emphasis without rewriting structure.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run typography fixes only on this Markdown file. Keep the current headings, lists, and frontmatter unchanged.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare for Publication
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced formatting for a blog or documentation pipeline.
prompt_templates.prompt: Format this article for publication. Create frontmatter, infer a slug, generate a short summary, preserve tone, and report the changes.

output_examples.input: A plain text article with several long paragraphs and three product benefits in one sentence.
output_examples.output: A Markdown article with frontmatter, a concise title, separated paragraphs, bold key points, and a clear benefit list.

output_examples.input: An existing Markdown draft with a duplicate title and inconsistent section hierarchy.
output_examples.output: A cleaned Markdown draft where the title is stored in frontmatter and the body uses consistent headings.

output_examples.input: A bilingual Markdown note with mixed CJK and English spacing issues.
output_examples.output: A formatted Markdown copy with improved CJK spacing, fixed emphasis punctuation, and unchanged source meaning.

best_practices: Review the generated title, slug, and summary before publishing.
Keep the original draft until the formatted copy has been checked.
Disable quote or spacing options when a publication style guide requires different typography.
anti_patterns: Running the formatter on files that should not be overwritten.
Using the skill to change facts, conclusions, or the author viewpoint.
Trusting hidden EXTEND.md settings from shared repositories without review.

faq.question: Does this skill rewrite my article?
faq.answer: No. It is designed to preserve the original meaning and add Markdown structure.

faq.question: Can it work with plain text?
faq.answer: Yes. It can convert plain text into structured Markdown with frontmatter.

faq.question: Can it keep existing Markdown formatting?
faq.answer: Yes. It asks whether to optimize formatting, keep the structure, or apply typography fixes only.

faq.question: Does it support CJK typography?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes CJK emphasis fixes and CJK and English spacing cleanup.

faq.question: Where does it save the result?
faq.answer: It saves a formatted Markdown copy using the original filename with a formatted suffix.

faq.question: Does it run commands?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow can run local formatting scripts, so review command execution in restricted environments.
